newsitem.title: UK: Ford plans big job cuts at UK plant -paper.
newsitem.headline: Ford plans big job cuts at UK plant -paper.

text.p: Ford Motor Co expects up to 1,000 job cuts at its Halewood plant in north-west England as a result of a plan to replace in-house production of components with outside suppliers, the Guardian newspaper said on Thursday.
But it said some trade unionists are backing the idea because hundreds of new jobs would be created at an industrial park for the suppliers near Halewood.
"The multiplier effect in terms of jobs could be huge," the newspaper quoted an unnamed executive as saying.
Halewood makes some 800 cars a day and employs 4,500 people.
